name: B1090 - Web - Consumer Messaging and Video
description: Intent: Block-tier hard enforcement on Web clipboard paste and upload into the Consumer Messaging and Video surface at sensitivity floor [3,4] — shuts down sensitive data leaving through consumer chat / video tools (WhatsApp Web, Telegram, TikTok, Discord, etc.). Exclusions: no list-based exclusion — the entire channel is treated as Unauthorized; ships disabled — enable only after W1080 reviews confirm no legitimate business workflow depends on these channels. Requirements: WIP — pending analyst testing.
